observations: Photo 0 shows the retail cardboard box for a Maxmech welding machine.

claims.evidence: The model number MMA-350 on the box in photo 0 typically denotes 350 Amps.
This is a subjective marketing term; while 10.8KVA is a high rating, durability cannot be verified remotely.
The brand name is clearly printed on the box in photo 0.

risks.risk: The machine may be non-functional or have internal faults.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine powered on and successfully striking an arc.

risks.proof: A photo showing all included cables and accessories.

response.reason: Only the packaging is shown. The actual item must be visible to confirm its condition and presence before any valuation can be made.
